MP aims to be India's milk capital, CM announces plans

Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Dr. Mohan Yadav has announced plans to transform the state into India's milk capital within two years. This initiative is framed as a "milk revolution" that Madhya Pradesh aims to lead.
